_comment: Laptop Deal Radar - user-facing knobs. Edit these, then run: python scripts/collect.py

purchase_ceiling._comment: Delivered per-unit hard ceiling from the used-laptop-agent-fleet valuation method. Listings above it are marked as breaching the ceiling.

anchor_fallback._comment: Benchmark = what a TESTED, WARRANTED machine of that generation costs. A live scan overrides a (family, generation) pair only when 3+ observations agree. These fallbacks are the honest answer when the resellers do not stock the model this week.

11.note: verified Oct 2026: lowest warranted refurb, Latitude 5420 i5 16GB/256GB

10.note: estimated, between the 8th and 11th gen tiers

8.note: estimated from the agent-fleet lot and retail range

craigslist._comment: batch=N walks US regions in sequence: 1=sfbay 2=seattle 3=newyork 4=boston 7=losangeles 8=sandiego. Only batches answering 200 are used; 400s are skipped. Keep the request count modest - this is an undocumented internal endpoint.
